CSS Luminous Glowing Orb Buttons

The spherical volume of these orbs is sculpted through radial gradients and triple-pass box-shadow halos tied to a custom --glow-color variable. Each button executes bespoke vector kinematics: the plus rotates 180°, the export arrow cycles diagonally via @keyframes arrowFly, and the checkmark draws via stroke-dashoffset. On hover, a skewed glint sweeps across the orb while the label glides outward, transitioning filter: blur(0px).

CSS Skeuomorphic Steampunk Push Button

The button constructs a 7-tier skeuomorphic stack: outer chassis, brushed bronze bezel, dark bottle-glass lens, wire mesh, glowing filament, and specular glare. The bronze frame uses a 135° linear gradient with 4-way inset box-shadow passes to carve physical chamfers. An internal .amber-glow powered by mix-blend-mode: color-dodge pulses on hover, while active clicks ignite a white-hot core with mechanical tactile depression.

Frosted Glass Parallax Button in CSS

The architecture splits the button into two physical planes: a floating glass span faceplate and an underlying ::after substrate. JavaScript captures cursor coordinates to feed --_x-motion and --_y-motion variables into CSS, driving an inverse parallax shift on the substrate via the enter keyframe. The realistic frosted glass aesthetic combines dynamic backdrop-filter: blur() with an embedded SVG feTurbulence fractal noise map.

Glowing Neon Glassmorphism Buttons in CSS

The frosted glass aesthetic is built using backdrop-filter: blur(15px) paired with a translucent white fill and delicate boundary borders. Dynamic illumination radiates from behind via ::before and ::after neon tabs: upon hover, these backplates expand to 80% width, diffusing multi-tiered box-shadow glows through the glass layer. The interaction is completed by a skewed skewX(45deg) glint sweeping across the pill face.
